Meta.title: CompI · Your kitchen workspace
Meta.description: CompI brings plating guides, recipe sheets and team email together for your hotel kitchen.

Landing.lead: Your plating guides, recipe sheets and team email, all in one place.
Landing.heroAlt: A chef uses tweezers to garnish a plated fish with microgreens.
Landing.projectBody1: In a hotel kitchen, every dish passes through several hands. With CompI, the kitchen and front-of-house teams work from the same plating guide. The photo, the choice of tableware and the service notes are all there when a question comes up at the pass.
Landing.projectBody2: The chef organises the sheets by hotel and outlet. Each employee can access their team’s documents and use internal email to hand over service notes to the next shift.
Landing.toolsAlt: An open kitchen notebook beside fresh herbs and cooking utensils.
Landing.platingBody: Browse the published guides for each outlet, check how to plate each dish and download a Word or PDF copy.
Landing.recipesBody: If you have editing access, enter the ingredients, quantities, allergens and plating steps. Review the sheet and save it as a draft before publishing.
Landing.mailBody: Email your hotel colleagues, reply to shift updates and organise your messages with favourites and personal folders.

Home.title: Your kitchen, in harmony.
Home.intro: See your team’s activity and recipe sheets.
Home.noDocuments: There are no documents available to your account yet.

Verification.title: Two-step verification
Verification.wait: Wait a moment before trying again.
Verification.intro: We have emailed you a six-digit code. Enter it to sign in.
Verification.resent: We have sent you a new code.
Verification.invalid: That code is not correct. Check it and try again.
Verification.expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
Verification.locked: Too many attempts. Ask for a new code.
Verification.failed: The code could not be checked. Try again.

PasswordChange.title: Choose a new password
PasswordChange.intro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.
PasswordChange.hint: Choose a password of at least 10 characters, different from the temporary one.
PasswordChange.failed: The password could not be changed. Try again.

Recovery.title: Reset password
Recovery.intro: Enter the personal code you saved when you activated your account or from your workspace.
Recovery.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password and save a new recovery code.
Recovery.invalid: We couldn’t verify the email address and recovery code. Check both and make sure your account is still active.
Recovery.weak: Choose a different password with at least eight characters.
Recovery.failed: We couldn’t confirm the change. If the connection was interrupted, try signing in with your new password.

Invitation.title: Test account invitation
Invitation.intro: Set a password to sign in to your test account.
Invitation.unavailable: This invitation is unavailable. Ask your executive chef to check the test link.
Invitation.expired: This link has expired, was cancelled or has already been used. If you’ve already set a password, sign in to CompI.
Invitation.weak: Choose a different password with at least eight characters.
Invitation.failed: We couldn’t confirm activation. Try again, or sign in to CompI if you’ve already saved your password.
Invitation.activated: Your account is active. Sign in to CompI with your email address and password.
Invitation.interrupted: The connection was interrupted. Try again here. If your password was already saved, sign in to CompI.
Invitation.wait: Wait a moment before trying again.

Security.title: Account recovery
Security.intro: Keep your code somewhere private outside CompI. It lets you reset your password even if you can’t access your mailbox. Each code can be used once.
Security.configured: Your account already has a recovery code. Generating a new one will invalidate the current code.
Security.none: You don’t have a recovery code yet.
Security.confirmReplace: Replace your current code with a new one?
Security.copyNow: Copy this code now. This is the only place it’s shown.
Security.reauth: For security, sign out and sign back in with your password before generating a code.
Security.failed: We couldn’t generate the code. Try again.

Login.intro: Sign in with your employee account to open your hotel’s workspace.
Login.errorCredentials: Check your email address and password.
Login.errorRateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before signing in again.
Login.errorNetwork: Couldn’t connect to the sign-in service. Please try again.
